title: Slacking Evolution
description: Drop and merge 11 hilarious office slacking habits—from sipping water to the ultimate Paid-Relaxation King—with a one-tap Boss Coming spreadsheet shield.
controls: Drag or move pointer to aim and release to drop; merge matching icons to evolve. Use Pantry Shake, Mark All Read, and the Boss Coming spreadsheet shield anytime.
